review.code_discovery: Source inspected importer, report reconciliation, per-issue event pagination, normalization and DB comparison. Completeness applies to issue report: 13 pages, independently matched error-type totals. All selected samples validate app/version/package/issue/type/time. Supplemental listed events may differ from report totals; never substitute those counts or claim exhaustive raw events.
review.entrypoints: MCP discovery -> CLI report pagination -> per-issue events -> normalization -> existing importer dry-run/backup/transaction -> backup comparison
review.recovery_paths: Retain failed network/global-fetch attempts. Count discrepancies archived, no missing samples allowed. Import preserves prior versions, snapshots and triage with backup. No app behavior or remote states changed.
